visual_reviews.note: Readable core resources, DDR bidirectional links and Q3-only L2; representative cores explicitly described in catalogue.
Candidate checks, official evaluation, comparison and output form an unambiguous flow; no title overlap.
Two panels have readable scales and legend; log powers are legitimate mathematical superscripts.
Zero ratios and full distributions retained; capacity reference is distinct from observed curves.
Same-core and cross-core Task paths distinguish DDR movement and waiting rules.
Band and subgraph labels are explicit; example core queues are readable and jointly acyclic.
Both curves start at the defined one-core reference; markers and dashed baseline are distinct.
All 400 cells retained with a symmetric log-ratio colour scale; negative changes are not clipped.
Task count and per-Task size boxes are separate; outliers and log superscripts are visible.
COPY components and spill-positive case count are distinguishable; legend is separated from heading.
Observed static imbalance range is fully included; ideal-one reference and outliers are readable.
All 20 core/Pipe lanes have readable labels and a separate panel heading; sparse intervals preserved.
Conditional capacity and cross-core paths are labelled; local reuse is not depicted as permanent residency.
Before/after rows explicitly labelled; the illustrative dependency assumption is visible.
B standard reference curve and C3 baseline clearly separated; header does not cover plotting area.
All 100 sorted cases represented; 55 improving and 45 unchanged cases explained in the figure.
Boundary and spill components plus nonzero-case count are readable; no legend overlap.
Zero-spill cases remain in the ranking; cumulative contribution clearly distinguished from equal-contribution reference.
Within-request stage means and strict improvement counts use distinct axes; enlarged mean axis is visible.
Symmetric-log COPY changes and signed time changes retain all quadrants; no Pareto-optimality claim.
Five-core B activity lanes and units readable; chart described as a final-result case, not isolated causal proof.
Issue, hit/miss transport and completion-time insertion are separated; FIFO semantics readable.
PB/PL comparison paths and shared B numerator explicitly distinguish configuration and reselection effects.
Same-plan reference curves and two ratio definitions are clear; ratio-one line and enlarged right scale are visible.
Full gain range and negative points retained; boxes are described as distributions rather than confidence intervals.
Both case labels have leaders; case_026 is clear of axis ticks and the dense ratio-one cluster.
FIFO occupancy and cumulative byte-hit rate have separate units, shared event time and visible capacity bound.
Both panels share the same absolute time axis; all 40 labelled lanes retained; panel headings separated.
All 28 different-plan cases labelled; case_099 degradation retained; reference-one line clear.
All eight degradations labelled with six-decimal ratios; enlarged axis explicitly disclosed.
Fourteen complete groups, visible win/tie/loss counts and separate legend; no title collision.
All groups and four extended-budget markers shown; budget legend is above, not covering low observations.
